findings.title: Resume rejects planning items once their design exists
findings.description: A `slices-plan` item whose design was created but whose review exhausted its rounds is no longer returned by `cf.undesigned_slices`. Consequently, both retry and accept are rejected despite the report marking it `review_unresolved`. Reproduced with an open slice containing a design file. The planning-resume test masks this by returning no design whenever a plan argument is supplied. Support resuming existing flagged designs and test that real post-failure state.

findings.title: Malformed report items escape validation
findings.description: The casts do not validate JSON structure. A report containing `"items": [null]` raises `AttributeError` from `from_json`, bypassing `BatchReportLoadError` and the intended REJECTED outcome. Reproduced directly. Validate the report and item shapes at the file boundary, preferably with Pydantic, and cover malformed entries.

findings.title: Item resume performs blocking operations on the event loop
findings.description: The async resume path directly performs synchronous state reads, git subprocesses, Context Forge calls, and report writes. Git calls can block for 30 seconds; Context Forge subprocesses have no timeout. This violates the explicit async execution rule and can stall all other coroutine work while holding the checkout lock. Move blocking operations off-loop, bound subprocess execution, and test timeout observability.
